metas.name: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
metas.description: SpongeBob takes leave from Bikini Bottom in order to track down, with Patrick, King Neptune's stolen crown.

metas.name: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
metas.description: When a diabolical pirate above the sea steals the secret Krabby Patty formula, SpongeBob and his friends team up in order to get it back.

metas.name: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run
metas.description: After SpongeBob's beloved pet snail Gary is snail-napped, he and Patrick embark on an epic adventure to the Lost City of Atlantic City to bring Gary home.

metas.name: Ben 10: Secret of the Omnitrix
metas.description: When the Omnitrix begins a countdown to self-destruction, Ben and Gwen team up with Tetrax to find the watch's creator before it's too late.

metas.name: Ben 10: Race Against Time
metas.description: Returning home from summer vacation, Ben Tennyson must stop the interdimensional alien warlord Eon from unlocking the Hands of Armageddon and taking over the Omnitrix.

metas.name: Ben 10: Alien Swarm
metas.description: Teenage Ben Tennyson, Gwen, and Kevin Levin team up with Elena Validus to stop a hive mind of techno-organic alien microchips from taking over the planet.

metas.name: Ben 10: Destroy All Aliens
metas.description: While dealing with the end of summer vacation and a critically damaged Omnitrix, Ben Tennyson finds himself targeted by a mysterious alien bounty hunter.

metas.name: Ben 10 Versus the Universe: The Movie
metas.description: When Vilgax returns to destroy Earth and Ben is accidentally launched into deep space, Ben must stand trial before the Intergalactic Court and unlock the Omni-Naut armor.

metas.name: Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back
metas.description: Scientists genetically create a new Pokémon, Mewtwo, but the results are horrific and disastrous.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie 2000
metas.description: Ash Ketchum must gather the three spheres of fire, ice and lightning in order to restore balance to the Orange Islands.

metas.name: Pokémon 3 the Movie: Spell of the Unown
metas.description: In the town of Greenfield, a young, lonely girl's dreams and wishes are brought into reality by a collective of reality-warping Pokémon.

metas.name: Pokémon 4Ever: Celebi - Voice of the Forest
metas.description: Ash, Pikachu, Misty, and Brock meet Sammy, a boy transported forty years forward in time by the mythical Pokémon (Pokemon) Celebi, and must protect it from the Iron-Masked Marauder.

metas.name: Pokémon Heroes: Latios and Latias
metas.description: In the water-canal city of Alto Mare, Ash and Pikachu befriend the legendary dragon Pokémon (Pokemon) Latios and Latias and defend the Soul Dew from Team Rocket thieves Annie and Oakley.

metas.name: Pokémon: Jirachi - Wish Maker
metas.description: Awakening for only seven days every thousand years when the Millennium Comet appears, the Wish Pokémon (Pokemon) Jirachi bonds with Max and must be saved from a rogue magician.

metas.name: Pokémon: Destiny Deoxys
metas.description: In high-tech LaRousse City, an epic clash erupts between the extraterrestrial DNA Pokémon (Pokemon) Deoxys and the sky guardian Rayquaza, trapping Ash and his friends in the crossfire.

metas.name: Pokémon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew
metas.description: When Pikachu is spirited away to the Tree of Beginning by Mew, Ash awakens Sir Aaron's Aura Pokémon (Pokemon) Lucario to journey into the ancient crystal cavern.

metas.name: Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea
metas.description: Ash, May, and Pokémon (Pokemon) Ranger Jack Walker protect the Prince of the Sea, Manaphy, and the ancient Sea Temple Samiya from the pirate Phantom.

metas.name: Pokémon: The Rise of Darkrai
metas.description: In Alamos Town, a dimensional battle between the legendary Pokémon (Pokemon) Dialga and Palkia threatens to tear reality apart while the misunderstood Darkrai stands guard.

metas.name: Pokémon: Giratina and the Sky Warrior
metas.description: Ash, Dawn, and Brock help the Gratitude Pokémon (Pokemon) Shaymin return to the Gracidea flower garden while defending the Reverse World and Giratina from Zero.

metas.name: Pokémon: Arceus and the Jewel of Life
metas.description: When the Alpha Pokémon (Pokemon) Arceus awakens to judge humanity for an ancient betrayal, Dialga sends Ash, Dawn, and Brock back in time to change history.

metas.name: Pokémon—Zoroark: Master of Illusions
metas.description: Ash and his friends rescue the illusion-casting Pokémon (Pokemon) Zorua and Zoroark in Crown City before media mogul Grings Kodai can steal Celebi's time-ripple energy.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Black—Victini and Reshiram
metas.description: In Eindoak Town, Ash, Iris, and Cilan befriend the Victory Pokémon (Pokemon) Victini and call upon the legendary dragon Reshiram to save the Sword of the Vale.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: White—Victini and Zekrom
metas.description: Ash and his companions encounter the Mythical Pokémon (Pokemon) Victini and awaken the legendary dragon Zekrom to stop Damon's plan to move the Sword of the Vale.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Kyurem vs. the Sword of Justice
metas.description: Ash and his friends help the Colt Pokémon (Pokemon) Keldeo rescue the Swords of Justice—Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion—from the fearsome dragon Kyurem.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Genesect and the Legend Awakened
metas.description: When an army of five revived Paleozoic Pokémon (Pokemon) Genesect attacks New Tork City, Mega Mewtwo Y intervenes alongside Ash and Pikachu to stop the destruction.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction
metas.description: Ash, Serena, Clemont, and Bonnie accompany the Jewel Pokémon (Pokemon) Diancie in search of the Life Pokémon Xerneas before the Destruction Pokémon Yveltal awakens.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Hoopa and the Clash of Ages
metas.description: In Dahara City, the Mythical Pokémon (Pokemon) Hoopa's Prison Bottle is broken, unleashing Hoopa Unbound and summoning legendary Pokémon from across space and time.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel
metas.description: Bound together by a magnetic chain, Ash and the Steam Pokémon (Pokemon) Volcanion storm the clockwork Azoth Kingdom to rescue the artificial Soul-Heart Pokémon Magearna.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!
metas.description: Retelling the beginning of Ash Ketchum and Pikachu's bond, the duo sets out from Pallet Town with a Rainbow Wing to meet the legendary Pokémon (Pokemon) Ho-Oh at Mount Tensei.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us
metas.description: During the annual Wind Festival in Fula City, Ash and Pikachu unite a diverse group of townspeople and the Mythical Pokémon (Pokemon) Zeraora to save the city and Lugia.

metas.name: Pokémon: Mewtwo Strikes Back - Evolution
metas.description: A CGI remake of the classic first Pokémon (Pokemon) movie in which the genetically engineered psychic Pokémon Mewtwo invites Ash, Misty, and Brock to New Island.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle
metas.description: Deep in the Forest of Okoya, Ash and Pikachu meet Koko, a human boy raised by the Mythical Pokémon (Pokemon) Zarude, and join forces to defend the jungle's healing spring.

metas.name: Digimon: The Movie
metas.description: Throughout three different stories, Kari Kamiya and her friends take on explosive adventures involving digital creatures.

metas.name: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Movie
metas.description: Underneath the sands of Egypt, Anubis, an ancient evil spirit, has awakened. It's up to Yugi, who defeated Anubis centuries ago, to use his skill and determination to rid the world of evil once again.

metas.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Bonds Beyond Time
metas.description: Three generations of Duel Monsters heroes—Yugi Muto, Jaden Yuki, and Yusei Fudo—unite across time to defeat Paradox and his Malefic dragons.

metas.name: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Dark Side of Dimensions
metas.description: Set after the original manga, Seto Kaiba excavates the Millennium Puzzle to duel the Pharaoh one last time while a mysterious boy named Aigami wields the Quantum Cube.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods
metas.description: Awakening from a 39-year slumber, Beerus the God of Destruction travels to Earth in search of the prophesied Super Saiyan God, pushing Goku to a new realm of divine power.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection 'F'
metas.description: Resurrected by Earth's Dragon Balls, galactic tyrant Frieza trains for the first time in his life to unlock his Golden Frieza form and exact revenge on Goku and Vegeta.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Super: Broly
metas.description: Goku and Vegeta encounter Broly, an exiled Saiyan warrior with limitless latent battle power brought to Earth by Frieza, leading to an earth-shattering clash.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero
metas.description: When the Red Ribbon Army resurfaces with powerful new androids Gamma 1, Gamma 2, and Cell Max, Piccolo and Gohan unlock new transformations to defend Earth.

metas.name: Phineas and Ferb the Movie: Across the 2nd Dimension
metas.description: Phineas and Ferb discover that Perry is a secret agent and they all get stuck in an alternate dimension where Doofenschmirtz is the ruler of the tri-state area.

metas.name: Phineas and Ferb the Movie: Candace Against the Universe
metas.description: The famed stepbrother inventors know what they're gonna do today. They're gonna rescue their sister from an alien abduction.

metas.name: The Powerpuff Girls Movie
metas.description: After destroying the city of Townsville in a game of tag, a trio of super-powered little girls must redeem themselves by stopping a vengeful monkey's plot for world domination.

metas.name: Ed, Edd n Eddy's Big Picture Show
metas.description: When a scam goes horribly wrong and leaves the neighborhood kids furious, the Eds embark on a journey to find Eddy's brother to save them from their consequences in the "Ed, Edd, n Eddy" series finale.

metas.name: Steven Universe: The Movie
metas.description: Steven thinks his time defending the Earth is over, but when a new threat comes to Beach City, Steven faces his biggest challenge yet.

metas.name: We Bare Bears: The Movie
metas.description: When their love of food trucks and viral videos gets out of hand, Grizz, Panda, and Ice Bear embark on a wild road trip to Canada while pursued by Agent Trout.

metas.name: Billy & Mandy's Big Boogey Adventure
metas.description: When the Boogey Man causes Grim to lose his powers, rank, and title in the Underworld Court for misusing his powers, he plots to seek out Horror's Hand and take over the world. It's up to Billy, Mandy, Irwin, and Grim to get to Ho...

metas.name: Codename: Kids Next Door - Operation Z.E.R.O.
metas.description: The knd must find a way to stop grandfather from ruling the world and turning everyone including adults into senior citizen zombies. Meanwhile numbuh one finds out his loser dad was the great numbuh zero.

metas.name: Regular Show: The Movie
metas.description: To save the universe, and their friendship, Mordecai and Rigby must defeat an evil volleyball coach.

metas.name: Teen Titans: Trouble in Tokyo
metas.description: After a battle with a high-tech villain, the Teen Titans travel to the city of Tokyo where they find themselves embroiled in a conflict with an ancient enemy.

metas.name: Teen Titans GO! To the Movies
metas.description: A villain's maniacal plan for world domination gets in the way of the Teen Titans' dream of superhero stardom in Hollywood.

metas.name: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
metas.description: An eight-year-old boy genius and his friends must rescue their parents after the adults are abducted by aliens.

metas.name: The Jimmy Timmy Power Hour
metas.description: When Timmy Turner wishes to be in the greatest lab in the universe, he swaps dimensions with boy genius Jimmy Neutron between Retroville and Dimmsdale.

metas.name: The Jimmy Timmy Power Hour 2: When Nerds Collide!
metas.description: Jimmy Neutron and Timmy Turner clash over Cindy Vortex while Professor Calamitous and Anti-Cosmo team up to free the anti-fairies.

metas.name: The Jimmy Timmy Power Hour 3: The Jerkinators!
metas.description: Jimmy Neutron and Timmy Turner accidentally create an unstoppable villain named Shirley who threatens to erase both Retroville and Dimmsdale.

metas.name: The Fairly OddParents: Abra-Catastrophe!
metas.description: Celebrating one full year with his fairy godparents Cosmo and Wanda, Timmy Turner receives a magical Rule-Free Muffin that falls into the hands of Mr. Crocker.

metas.name: The Fairly OddParents: Channel Chasers
metas.description: Armed with a magic TV remote, Timmy Turner jumps inside the television universe across parody cartoon channels while pursued by evil babysitter Vicky.

metas.name: The Rugrats Movie
metas.description: The babies gets lost in the forest after Tommy Pickles gets a new baby brother.

metas.name: Rugrats in Paris
metas.description: While on a family vacation in Paris, the Rugrats attempt to help Chuckie find a new mom while stopping his dad from marrying a conniving businesswoman who hates kids.

metas.name: Rugrats Go Wild
metas.description: The Rugrats get tangled in an exotic adventure, where they're helped by the Thornberrys, a family that travels the world making nature documentaries.

metas.name: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
metas.description: After losing a cheetah cub to ruthless poachers, Eliza must redeem her folly and go on a quest to save him.

metas.name: Hey Arnold! The Movie
metas.description: Arnold and company must recover a stolen document needed in order to prevent Hillwood from being bulldozed. So, Arnold and Gerald was risk their life to save their neighborhood in the nick of time.

metas.name: Hey Arnold: The Jungle Movie
metas.description: Picking up where Hey Arnold! (1996) left off, this tells the story of what happened to Arnold's parents.

metas.name: Recess: School's Out
metas.description: T.J. and the gang must save summer vacation from disappearing forever.

metas.name: Kim Possible: A Sitch in Time
metas.description: The new school year starts off terrible for Kim. In her ordinary life her best friend is moving away, and in her heroic crime-fighting life, three of the most notorious villains in her world plan to use time travel as a weapon aga...

metas.name: Kim Possible: So the Drama
metas.description: Kim's heart is quickly captured by the new boy, Eric, who soon becomes her boyfriend. Unknown to Kim, her best friend and sidekick, Ron has developed stronger feelings toward her.

metas.name: DuckTales: The Movie - Treasure of the Lost Lamp
metas.description: Scrooge McDuck takes Huey, Dewey, and Louie to Egypt to find a pyramid and magic lamp.

metas.name: A Goofy Movie
metas.description: When Max makes a preposterous promise to a girl he has a crush on, his chances to fulfilling it seem hopeless when he is dragged onto a cross-country trip with his embarrassing father, Goofy.

metas.name: An Extremely Goofy Movie
metas.description: Max goes to college, but to his embarassment his father loses his job and goes to his son's campus.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo on Zombie Island
metas.description: The Mystery Gang reunite and visit Moonscar Island, a remote island with a dark secret. Daphne wants more than just a villain in a costume, and they get more than they ever expected.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo and the Witch's Ghost
metas.description: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Gang visit Oakhaven, Massachusetts to seek strange goings on involving a famous horror novelist and his ancestor who is rumored be a witch.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo and the Alien Invaders
metas.description: A cosmic case of flying saucers, intergalactic intrigue and out-of-this-world romance launches Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Gang into their most unearthly adventure ever.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo and the Cyber Chase
metas.description: When Scooby and the gang get trapped in a video game created for them, they must fight against the 'Phantom Virus'. To escape the game they must go level by level and defeat the game once and for all.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo and the Legend of the Vampire
metas.description: The gang go to Australia to investigate the recent disappearances of the performances at the music festivals, by the so called 'Yowie Yahoo'.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo and the Monster of Mexico
metas.description: Join Scooby, Shaggy and the gang as they visit a friend in Mexico to celebrate the Day of the Dead! Only this time it's a monster that terrorizes the town.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! Pirates Ahoy!
metas.description: Arrgh. It's horror on the high seas when Scooby-Doo and the gang take a creepy cruise into one of the world's most mysterious places - the legendary Bermuda Triangle.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! Abracadabra-Doo
metas.description: Mystery Inc. visits Velma's younger sister Madelyn at the Whirlen Merlin Magic Academy, where a giant mythical Gryphon is terrorizing the castle grounds.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! Camp Scare
metas.description: Scooby-Doo, Shaggy, Freddy, Daphne and Velma fish for clues to solve the mysteries of The Woodsman, The Fishman and The Banshee of Black Canyon.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! Legend of the Phantosaur
metas.description: During a relaxing spa trip in New Mexico, Shaggy is hypnotized into becoming fearless while Mystery Inc. investigates a glowing prehistoric Phantosaur.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! Stage Fright
metas.description: Fred and Daphne compete as finalists on the television singing show Talent Star in Chicago while a masked Phantom haunts the historic opera house.

metas.name: Scoob!
metas.description: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang team up with the Blue Falcon to stop Dick Dastardly from unleashing the ghost dog Cerberus and opening the Underworld.

metas.name: Tom and Jerry: The Magic Ring
metas.description: Tom is left in charge of a priceless magical ring by his young wizard master. He is then horrified when the ring gets stuck on Jerry's head, who then runs off into the city.

metas.name: Tom and Jerry Blast Off to Mars!
metas.description: While carrying on their usual chases, Tom and Jerry inadvertently stow-away on a spaceship bound for Mars.

metas.name: Tom and Jerry: The Fast and the Furry
metas.description: After wrecking their house during a chase, Tom and Jerry enter a race around the world where the winner gets a new fancy house.

metas.name: Tom and Jerry: Shiver Me Whiskers
metas.description: Aboard the pirate ship of Captain Red, Tom and Jerry find a treasure map to the Spanish Main guarded by a giant octopus and a ghost pirate crew.

metas.name: Tom and Jerry: A Nutcracker Tale
metas.description: In an empty opera house on Christmas Eve, Jerry's wish brings a magical toy kingdom to life until Tom and a band of alley cats invade to Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker score.

metas.name: Tom and Jerry Meet Sherlock Holmes
metas.description: In Victorian London, Tom and Jerry assist legendary detective Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson in clearing singer Red's name after Professor Moriarty steals the crown jewels.

metas.name: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm
metas.description: Batman is wrongly implicated in a series of murders of mob bosses actually committed by a new vigilante assassin.

metas.name: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker
metas.description: The Joker is back with a vengeance, and Gotham's newest Dark Knight needs answers as he stands alone to face Gotham's most infamous Clown Prince of Crime.

metas.name: The Batman vs. Dracula
metas.description: Batman faces off against the original creature of the night, Count Dracula, who has been unintentionally resurrected by the Penguin.

metas.name: Batman: Under the Red Hood
metas.description: There's a mystery afoot in Gotham City, and Batman must go toe-to-toe with a mysterious vigilante, who goes by the name of Red Hood. Subsequently, old wounds reopen and old, once buried memories come into the light.

metas.name: Batman: Assault on Arkham
metas.description: Batman works desperately to find a bomb planted by the Joker while Amanda Waller sends her newly formed Suicide Squad to break into Arkham Asylum to recover vital information.

metas.name: Superman/Batman: Public Enemies
metas.description: When Lex Luthor gets elected US President, he uses the threat of an oncoming kryptonite meteor striking Earth as a rationale to frame Superman.

metas.name: Justice League: Crisis on Two Earths
metas.description: A good version of Lex Luthor from a parallel Earth comes to the Justice League's dimension for help to fight their evil counterparts.

metas.name: Justice League: Doom
metas.description: Vandal Savage steals confidential files Batman has compiled on the members of the Justice League, and learns all their weaknesses.

metas.name: Justice League: The Flashpoint Paradox
metas.description: The Flash finds himself in a war torn alternate timeline and teams up with alternate versions of his fellow heroes to return home and restore the timeline.

metas.name: Justice League: War
metas.description: The world's finest superheroes—Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, Green Lantern, The Flash, Shazam, and Cyborg—meet for the first time to stop an alien invasion led by Darkseid.

metas.name: Justice League Dark
metas.description: When innocent civilians begin committing unthinkable crimes across Metropolis and Gotham, Batman recruits John Constantine, Zatanna, Deadman, and Etrigan the Demon.

metas.name: Justice League Dark: Apokolips War
metas.description: After a devastating invasion by Darkseid decimates Earth and the Justice League, the surviving heroes rally around Superman, John Constantine, Raven, and Damian Wayne for a final stand.

metas.name: The Death of Superman
metas.description: When a hulking monster named Doomsday arrives on Earth and begins a mindless rampage across Metropolis, the Justice League falls and only Superman can stand in its way.

metas.name: Reign of the Supermen
metas.description: After the death of Superman, four new superpowered figures—Superboy, Steel, the Eradicator, and Cyborg Superman—emerge in Metropolis claiming the mantle of the Man of Steel.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Traveling across the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-People, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes clash over how to deal with a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads.

metas.name: Ultimate Avengers: The Movie
metas.description: To confront an alien menace, General Fury assembles a team of superheroes lead by a recently resuscitated Captain America.

metas.name: Planet Hulk
metas.description: The Incredible Hulk, ejected from Earth in a spaceship, crash-lands on a planet ruled by a tyrant, who forces him to fight in a coliseum against other powerful creatures. The Hulk reluctantly befriends the combatants on his team.

metas.name: The Transformers: The Movie
metas.description: The Autobots must stop a colossal planet-consuming robot who goes after the Autobot Matrix of Leadership. At the same time, they must defend themselves against an all-out attack from the Decepticons.

metas.name: TMNT
metas.description: When the world is threatened by an ancient evil, the Ninja Turtles must reunite and overcome their faults in order to stand against it.

metas.name: Turtles Forever
metas.description: The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles meet their match -- Literally! The modern, gritty Ninja Turtles must team up with their classic cartoon counterparts to stop two Shredders and their plans of multi-dimensional scale.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: An ordinary LEGO construction worker named Emmet Brickowski, thought to be the prophesied 'Special', is recruited to join a quest to stop the evil tyrant Lord Business.

metas.name: The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part
metas.description: It's been five years since everything was awesome and the citizens are facing a huge new threat: LEGO DUPLO invaders from outer space, wrecking everything faster than they can rebuild.

metas.name: The Lego Batman Movie
metas.description: A cooler-than-ever Bruce Wayne must deal with the usual suspects as they plan to rule Gotham City, while discovering that he has accidentally adopted a teenage orphan who wishes to become Robin.

metas.name: Toy Story
metas.description: A cowboy doll is profoundly jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as the top toy in a boy's bedroom. When circumstances separate them from their owner, the duo have to put aside their differences to return to him.

metas.name: Toy Story 2
metas.description: When Woody is stolen by a toy collector, Buzz and his friends set out on a rescue mission to save Woody before he becomes a museum toy property with his roundup gang Jessie, Prospector, and Bullseye.

metas.name: Toy Story 3
metas.description: As Andy prepares to leave for college, Woody, Buzz and the gang face an uncertain future when a mix-up sends them to a daycare center full of new toys.

metas.name: Toy Story 4
metas.description: When Bonnie creates a reluctant new toy named Forky out of a spork, Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and the gang embark on a road trip where Woody reunites with Bo Peep.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: While trying to lead a quiet suburban life, a family of undercover superheroes are forced into action to save the world.

metas.name: Incredibles 2
metas.description: Elastigirl is recruited to lead a campaign to bring Supers back into the spotlight while Mr. Incredible stays home to care for Violet, Dash, and baby Jack-Jack's emerging powers.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: Two monsters whose job is to make human children scream accidentally let a little girl into their world and must now protect her from their own kind to return her home unscathed.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: Before becoming top scarers at Monsters, Inc., college rivals Mike Wazowski and James P. Sullivan must team up with a fraternity of misfits to win the Scare Games.

metas.name: Finding Nemo
metas.description: After his son is captured in the Great Barrier Reef and taken to Sydney, a timid clownfish sets out on a journey to bring him home.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: Friendly but forgetful blue tang fish Dory suddenly remembers her childhood family and sets off across the ocean with Marlin and Nemo to the Marine Life Institute in California.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: On the way to the biggest race of his life, a hotshot rookie race car gets stranded in a rundown town and learns that winning isn't everything in life.

metas.name: Cars 2
metas.description: Star race car Lightning McQueen and his tow-truck best friend Mater head overseas for the World Grand Prix, where Mater gets caught up in international espionage with Finn McMissile.

metas.name: Cars 3
metas.description: Blindsided by a new generation of blazing-fast high-tech rookies led by Jackson Storm, Lightning McQueen teams up with eager young race technician Cruz Ramirez to make a comeback.

metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: After young Riley is uprooted from her Midwest life and moved to San Francisco, her emotions—Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust, and Sadness—conflict on how best to navigate a new city.

metas.name: Inside Out 2
metas.description: As Riley enters puberty and heads to high school hockey camp, Headquarters undergoes a sudden demolition to make room for new emotions led by Anxiety, Envy, Ennui, and Embarrassment.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A misfit ant named Flik, looking for tough warriors to save his colony from greedy grasshoppers led by Hopper, inadvertently recruits a troupe of circus bugs.

metas.name: Ratatouille
metas.description: A rat who can cook makes an unusual alliance with a young kitchen worker at a famous Paris restaurant.

metas.name: WALL·E
metas.description: In a future where humans have temporarily abandoned Earth, a trash-compacting robot falls in love with a flying droid and helps her on her quest to restore hope to mankind.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A grumpy old man turns his house into an airship using balloons and flies off to South America with a young stowaway.

metas.name: Coco
metas.description: Aspiring young musician Miguel, confronted with his family's ancestral ban on music, enters the vibrant Land of the Dead to unlock the real story behind his family history.

metas.name: Shrek
metas.description: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre, who must go on a quest and rescue a princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

metas.name: Shrek 2
metas.description: Shrek and Fiona travel to the Kingdom of Far Far Away, where Fiona's parents are King and Queen, to celebrate their marriage. When they arrive, they find they are not as welcome as they thought they would be.

metas.name: Shrek the Third
metas.description: Reluctant to become the next King of Far Far Away, Shrek sets out with Donkey and Puss in Boots to bring Princess Fiona's rebellious cousin Artie to the throne while Prince Charming plots a coup.

metas.name: Shrek Forever After
metas.description: Longing for the days when he felt like a real ogre, Shrek signs a deceptive pact with Rumpelstiltskin and wakes up in an alternate Far Far Away where he and Fiona never met.

metas.name: Puss in Boots
metas.description: Long before meeting Shrek, the notorious outlaw Puss in Boots teams up with mastermind Humpty Dumpty and street-savvy Kitty Softpaws to steal the legendary Golden Goose.

metas.name: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
metas.description: Discovering that his passion for adventure has burned through eight of his nine lives, Puss in Boots embarks on an epic quest into the Dark Forest to find the mythical Wishing Star.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda
metas.description: To everyone's surprise, including his own, Po, an overweight, clumsy panda, is chosen as protector of the Valley of Peace. His suitability will soon be tested as the valley's arch-enemy is on his way.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 2
metas.description: Po and his friends fight to stop a peacock villain from conquering China with a deadly new weapon, but first the Dragon Warrior must come to terms with his past.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Reunited with his long-lost biological father Li Shan, Po travels to a secret panda village and must train a clumsy community of pandas to defeat the supernatural warrior Kai.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 4
metas.description: Tapped to become the Spiritual Leader of the Valley of Peace, Po teams up with a quick-witted corsac fox thief named Zhen to stop a shape-shifting sorceress known as The Chameleon.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A hapless young Viking who aspires to hunt dragons becomes the unlikely friend of a young dragon himself, and learns there may be more to the creatures than he assumed.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: Five years after uniting dragons and Vikings on Berk, Hiccup and Toothless discover a secret ice cave, Hiccup's long-lost mother Valka, and the dragon-conquering warlord Drago Bludvist.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
metas.description: When Toothless discovers an untamed, elusive Light Fury and the ruthless Night Fury hunter Grimmel threatens Berk, Hiccup and Toothless journey to the mythical Hidden World.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A group of animals who have spent all their life in a New York zoo end up in the jungles of Madagascar, and must adjust to living in the wild.

metas.name: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
metas.description: Attempting to fly back to New York aboard a patched-up plane, Alex, Marty, Melman, Gloria, and the Penguins crash-land on the plains of Africa, where Alex meets his real lion family.

metas.name: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted
metas.description: Hunted across Monte Carlo by relentless animal-control officer Captain Chantel DuBois, Alex, Marty, Melman, and Gloria hide out by joining a traveling European circus.

metas.name: Penguins of Madagascar
metas.description: Elite undercover flightless birds Skipper, Kowalski, Rico, and Private join forces with the North Wind spy agency to stop villainous octopus Dr. Octavius Brine from taking over the world.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: After their cave is destroyed, a prehistoric family led by overprotective patriarch Grug embarks on a journey through a fantastical new world with an inventive nomad named Guy.

metas.name: The Croods: A New Age
metas.description: Searching for a safer habitat, the prehistoric Crood family discovers a walled-in paradise created by the more evolved Betterman family.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: The villainous Megamind finally defeats his do-gooder nemesis, Metro Man, but is left without a purpose in a superhero-free world.

metas.name: Over the Hedge
metas.description: A scheming raccoon fools a mismatched family of forest creatures into helping him repay a debt of food, by invading the new suburban sprawl that popped up while they were hibernating...and learns a lesson about family himself.

metas.name: Flushed Away
metas.description: The story of an uptown rat that gets flushed down the toilet from his penthouse apartment, ending in the sewers of London, where he has to learn a whole new and different way of life.

metas.name: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
metas.description: Wallace and his loyal dog, Gromit, set out to discover the mystery behind the garden sabotage that plagues their village and threatens the annual giant vegetable growing contest.

metas.name: Chicken Run
metas.description: When a cockerel named Rocky apparently flies into a Yorkshire chicken farm, the hens led by Ginger see him as their only hope to escape before Mrs. Tweedy turns them into chicken pies.

metas.name: The Prince of Egypt
metas.description: Raised as an Egyptian prince alongside his adoptive brother Rameses, Moses discovers his Hebrew heritage and is called upon to lead his people out of slavery.

metas.name: The Road to El Dorado
metas.description: Two sixteenth-century Spanish con men, Tulio and Miguel, win a map to the legendary City of Gold and are mistaken for gods by the inhabitants of El Dorado.

metas.name: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron
metas.description: A wild Kiger mustang stallion captured by the U.S. Cavalry forms an unbreakable bond with a young Lakota warrior named Little Creek while fighting to reclaim his freedom.

metas.name: Shark Tale
metas.description: When a fast-talking whale-wash fish named Oscar falsely takes credit for slaying the son of a shark mob boss, he teams up with vegetarian great white shark Lenny to keep up the ruse.

metas.name: Bee Movie
metas.description: Fresh out of college, disillusioned honeybee Barry B. Benson befriends New York florist Vanessa and sues the human race after discovering that people have been eating bees' honey.

metas.name: Monsters vs. Aliens
metas.description: Struck by a radioactive meteor on her wedding day and growing to 49 feet tall, Susan Murphy (Ginormica) is recruited into a secret government team of monsters to stop alien invader Gallaxhar.

metas.name: Rise of the Guardians
metas.description: When the evil spirit Pitch Black launches an assault on the hopes and dreams of children, the immortal Guardians—Santa Claus, the Easter Bunny, the Tooth Fairy, and Sandman—recruit Jack Frost.

metas.name: Ice Age
metas.description: During the onset of the Ice Age, a woolly mammoth named Manny, a talkative sloth named Sid, and a saber-toothed tiger named Diego form an unlikely herd to return a lost human baby.

metas.name: Ice Age: The Meltdown
metas.description: Manny, Sid, and Diego discover that the warming climate is about to flood their valley and set out toward higher ground along with Ellie, a female mammoth who thinks she's a possum.

metas.name: Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs
metas.description: When Sid adopts three Tyrannosaurus eggs and is carried into a lush subterranean dinosaur world, Manny, Ellie, and Diego team up with one-eyed weasel Buck to rescue him.

metas.name: Ice Age: Continental Drift
metas.description: After Scrat's pursuit of his acorn triggers a continental cataclysm, Manny, Diego, and Sid are set adrift on an iceberg and clash with Captain Gutt's crew of seafaring pirates.

metas.name: Ice Age: Collision Course
metas.description: When Scrat accidentally launches a UFO into outer space and sends a giant asteroid hurtling toward Earth, Buck leads Manny, Sid, and Diego on a mission to stop the impact.

metas.name: Despicable Me
metas.description: When a criminal mastermind named Gru uses a trio of orphan girls—Margo, Edith, and Agnes—as pawns for a grand scheme to steal the Moon, he finds their love profoundly changing him.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: Now a devoted father to Margo, Edith, and Agnes, former supervillain Gru is recruited by the Anti-Villain League and partnered with Agent Lucy Wilde to stop El Macho.

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: Gru meets his long-lost charming, cheerful, and more successful twin brother Dru, who wants to team up with him for one last criminal heist against former child star Balthazar Bratt.

metas.name: Despicable Me 4
metas.description: Gru, Lucy, Margo, Edith, Agnes, and baby Gru Jr. relocate to the safe-house town of Mayflower while evading escaped French supervillain Maxime Le Mal.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: Evolving from single-celled yellow organisms at the dawn of time, Minions Kevin, Stuart, and Bob travel to 1968 London and are recruited by supervillain Scarlet Overkill.

metas.name: Minions: The Rise of Gru
metas.description: In the 1970s, twelve-year-old Gru schemes to join the supervillain group the Vicious 6 and relies on Kevin, Stuart, Bob, and Otto to rescue him when the heist goes wrong.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: Count Dracula operates a lavish five-stake resort where monsters can relax away from the human world—until a carefree human backpacker stumbles in and falls for Dracula's daughter Mavis.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania 2
metas.description: Now open to human guests, Hotel Transylvania sees Dracula secretly put his half-human, half-vampire grandson Dennis through a 'monster-in-training' boot camp with his monster pals.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation
metas.description: Count Dracula and his monster family embark on a luxury monster cruise ship vacation, unaware that the ship's captain Ericka is the descendant of Abraham Van Helsing.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania: Transformania
metas.description: When Van Helsing's mysterious Monsterfication Ray goes haywire, Johnny is turned into a dragon monster while Dracula and his pals are transformed into ordinary humans.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: Eccentric young inventor Flint Lockwood builds a machine that turns water in the atmosphere into raining cheeseburgers and pancakes over the island town of Swallow Falls.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
metas.description: Flint Lockwood and his friends return to Swallow Falls after discovering that his FLDSMDFR machine is still running and creating an ecosystem of living foodimals.

metas.name: Rio
metas.description: Domesticated Spix's macaw Blu, who never learned to fly in Minnesota, is taken to Rio de Janeiro to meet the fiercely independent Jewel and escape animal smugglers.

metas.name: Rio 2
metas.description: Blu, Jewel, and their three kids leave their domesticated life in Rio de Janeiro for an expedition deep into the Amazon rainforest, where Jewel reunites with her long-lost flock.

metas.name: Open Season
metas.description: Pampered 900-pound grizzly bear Boog and fast-talking one-antlered mule deer Elliot find themselves stranded in the woods three days before hunting season opens.

metas.name: Open Season 2
metas.description: When Mr. Weenie is kidnapped by a group of pampered domestic pets led by Fifi the poodle, Boog, Elliot, McSquizzy, and the forest animals go undercover to rescue him.

metas.name: Open Season 3
metas.description: Boog swaps places with a look-alike circus grizzly bear named Doug and falls for Russian trapeze bear Ursa, prompting Elliot and the woodland crew to stage a rescue.

metas.name: Surf's Up
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes mockumentary following teenage rockhopper penguin Cody Maverick as he leaves Shiverpool, Antarctica to enter the Big Z Memorial Surf Off on Pen Gu Island.

metas.name: Robots
metas.description: In a world of sentient robots, idealistic young inventor Rodney Copperbottom travels to Robot City to meet his idol Bigweld and teams up with the Rusties to stop corporate tyrant Ratchet.

metas.name: Horton Hears a Who!
metas.description: Horton the Elephant hears a faint cry for help coming from a microscopic speck of dust floating through the air and vows to protect the tiny community of Whoville inside it.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: Charlie Brown embarks on a quest to impress the Little Red-Haired Girl while his beagle Snoopy takes to the skies to pursue his arch-nemesis, the Red Baron.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.

metas.name: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride
metas.description: Simba and Nala's adventurous daughter Kiara falls in love with Kovu, a young lion from the banished Outsider pride raised to avenge Scar, sparking a struggle to unite the Pride Lands.

metas.name: The Lion King 1½
metas.description: Timon the meerkat and Pumbaa the warthog fast-forward and rewind through the events of The Lion King to reveal their own hilarious behind-the-scenes story.

metas.name: Aladdin
metas.description: A kind-hearted street urchin and a power-hungry Grand Vizier vie for a magic lamp that has the power to make their deepest wishes come true.

metas.name: The Return of Jafar
metas.description: Escaping from his lamp in the Cave of Wonders as an all-powerful genie, Jafar returns to Agrabah to exact revenge on Aladdin, Jasmine, Genie, and a reformed Iago.

metas.name: Aladdin and the King of Thieves
metas.description: When the Forty Thieves crash Aladdin and Princess Jasmine's wedding in search of the Oracle, Aladdin discovers that the King of Thieves is his long-lost father Cassim.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A young and parentless girl adopts a 'dog' from the local pound, completely unaware that it's supposedly a dangerous scientific experiment that's taken refuge on Earth and is now hiding from its creator and those who see it as a m...

metas.name: Stitch! The Movie
metas.description: Stitch, an alien living on Earth disguised as a dog with his human family, continues his adventures when he discovers that the alien family he never knew he had is now in Hawaii, being hunted down by galactic forces.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch 2: Stitch Has a Glitch
metas.description: A malfunction threatens to destroy Stitch and his friendship with Lilo!

metas.name: Leroy & Stitch
metas.description: New circumstances forces Lilo and her alien friends to part ways while Gantu and Dr. Van Hamsterviel create the Stitch clone, Leroy, in order to capture all of the experiments and take over the galaxy.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: Emperor Kuzco is turned into a llama by his ex-administrator Yzma, and must now regain his throne and his human form with the help of Pacha, a gentle llama herder.

metas.name: Kronk's New Groove
metas.description: Now the head chef and delivery boy at Mudka's Meat Hut, former henchman Kronk scrambles to acquire a house on the hill before his hard-to-please father Papi visits.

metas.name: Atlantis: The Lost Empire
metas.description: In 1914, a young linguist is tasked by an intrepid group of mercenaries with deciphering an ancient text that will lead them to the lost city of Atlantis.

metas.name: Atlantis: Milo's Return
metas.description: Milo Thatch and Queen Kida reunite with their surface expedition crew to investigate ancient Atlantean monsters and artifacts awakening across the globe.

metas.name: Treasure Planet
metas.description: Jim Hawkins is a teenager who finds the map of a great treasure hidden by a space pirate. Together with some friends, he sets off in a large spaceship, shaped like a caravel, on his quest.

metas.name: Tarzan
metas.description: A man raised by gorillas must decide where he really belongs when he discovers he is a human.

metas.name: Tarzan II
metas.description: Before becoming King of the Jungle, young Tarzan runs away from his gorilla troop after feeling like an outcast and meets the legendary hermit ape Zugor on Dark Mountain.

metas.name: Tarzan & Jane
metas.description: Celebrating their first anniversary in the African jungle, Jane reminisces with Terk and Tantor about three wild adventures from her first year living with Tarzan.

metas.name: Hercules
metas.description: The son of Zeus and Hera is stripped of his immortality as an infant and must become a true hero in order to reclaim it.

metas.name: Mulan
metas.description: To save her father from death in the army, a young maiden secretly goes in his place and becomes one of China's greatest heroines in the process.

metas.name: Mulan II
metas.description: Newly engaged Mulan and General Li Shang escort three Chinese princesses to a diplomatic marriage alliance while Mushu schemes to keep Mulan from losing him as her guardian.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: Ralph is tired of playing the role of a bad guy and embarks on a journey to become a video game hero. But he accidentally lets loose a deadly enemy that threatens the entire arcade.

metas.name: Ralph Breaks the Internet
metas.description: Six years after saving the arcade, Wreck-It Ralph and Vanellope von Schweetz venture into the uncharted expanse of the Internet via a newly installed Wi-Fi router to find a replacement Sugar Rush wheel.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A special bond develops between plus-sized inflatable robot Baymax and prodigy Hiro Hamada, who together team up with a group of friends to form a band of high-tech heroes.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: When the newly crowned Queen Elsa accidentally uses her power to turn things into ice to curse her home in infinite winter, her sister Anna teams up with Kristoff, Sven, and Olaf.

metas.name: Frozen II
metas.description: Anna, Elsa, Kristoff, Olaf, and Sven leave Arendelle to travel to an ancient, autumn-bound enchanted forest to find the origin of Elsa's magical powers and save their kingdom.

metas.name: Tangled
metas.description: The magically long-haired Rapunzel has spent her entire life in a hidden tower, but now that a runaway thief named Flynn Rider has stumbled upon her, she is about to discover the world.

metas.name: Zootopia
metas.description: In a city of anthropomorphic animals, rookie bunny cop Judy Hopps and cynical con-artist fox Nick Wilde must work together to uncover a conspiracy involving missing predators.

metas.name: Moana
metas.description: In Ancient Polynesia, when a terrible curse incurred by the Demigod Maui reaches Moana's island, she answers the Ocean's call to seek out Maui to set things right.

metas.name: Encanto
metas.description: A Colombian teenage girl has to face the frustration of being the only member of her family without magical powers—until she discovers that the magic surrounding the Encanto is in danger.

metas.name: Brother Bear
metas.description: When an impulsive young Inuit hunter named Kenai avenges his brother by killing a bear, the Spirits magically transform him into a bear and pair him with a talkative cub named Koda.

metas.name: Brother Bear 2
metas.description: Kenai and Koda help Kenai's childhood friend Nita journey to Hokani Falls to burn an amulet and break a childhood bond before her wedding.

metas.name: Meet the Robinsons
metas.description: Orphaned twelve-year-old boy inventor Lewis is whisked away to the year 2037 by Wilbur Robinson to stop the Bowler Hat Guy from altering the future.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: The canine star of a fictional sci-fi action show who believes his superpowers are real embarks on a cross-country trek from New York to Hollywood with alley cat Mittens and hamster Rhino.

metas.name: The Little Mermaid
metas.description: Mermaid princess Ariel makes a Faustian bargain with the sea witch Ursula, trading her voice for human legs in hopes of winning the heart of Prince Eric on land.

metas.name: The Little Mermaid II: Return to the Sea
metas.description: Ariel and Eric's daughter Melody, kept away from the ocean to protect her from Ursula's vengeful sister Morgana, longs to swim in the sea and is transformed into a mermaid.

metas.name: Beauty and the Beast
metas.description: A prince cursed to spend his days as a hideous monster sets out to regain his humanity by earning a young woman's love before the last petal falls from an enchanted rose.

metas.name: The Jungle Book
metas.description: Bagheera the Panther and Baloo the Bear have a difficult time trying to convince a boy named Mowgli to leave the Indian jungle before the evil tiger Shere Khan arrives.

metas.name: The Jungle Book 2
metas.description: Now living in the Man-Village, Mowgli misses his carefree jungle life with Baloo and sneaks back into the wild, unaware that Shere Khan is waiting for revenge.

metas.name: Peter Pan
metas.description: Wendy and her two brothers are whisked away to the magical world of Neverland with the hero of their stories, Peter Pan, and Tinker Bell to face Captain Hook.

metas.name: Return to Never Land
metas.description: In World War II London, Wendy's pragmatic daughter Jane refuses to believe in Peter Pan—until Captain Hook mistakes her for Wendy and kidnaps her to Neverland.

metas.name: One Hundred and One Dalmatians
metas.description: When a litter of Dalmatian puppies are abducted by the minions of Cruella de Vil, the parents Pongo and Perdita must find them before she uses them for a fur coat.

metas.name: 101 Dalmatians II: Patch's London Adventure
metas.description: Accidentally left behind when the Radcliffe family moves to the countryside, puppy Patch teams up with his TV hero Thunderbolt in London to rescue his siblings from Cruella de Vil.

metas.name: The Rescuers Down Under
metas.description: Rescue Aid Society mice Bernard and Miss Bianca fly to the Australian Outback aboard Wilbur the albatross to save a young boy named Cody and a giant golden eagle from poacher McLeach.

metas.name: The Fox and the Hound
metas.description: An orphaned red fox named Tod and a hound puppy named Copper form a deep childhood friendship that is tested when they grow up into natural enemies.

metas.name: Bambi
metas.description: The story of a young deer growing up in the forest alongside his friends Thumper the rabbit and Flower the skunk after his mother is shot by hunters.

metas.name: Bambi II
metas.description: After the loss of his mother, young Bambi is raised through the winter by his stoic father, the Great Prince of the Forest, as both learn from one another.

metas.name: Cinderella
metas.description: When Cinderella's cruel stepmother prevents her from attending the Royal Ball, she gets some unexpected help from the lovable mice Gus and Jaq and from her Fairy Godmother.

metas.name: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
metas.description: A collection of three classic animated shorts following honey-loving bear Winnie the Pooh, Christopher Robin, Piglet, Tigger, and Eeyore through the Hundred Acre Wood.

metas.name: Winnie the Pooh
metas.description: While searching for a replacement tail for Eeyore, Winnie the Pooh and his friends misread a note from Christopher Robin and set out to rescue him from the imaginary 'Backson'.

metas.name: The Nightmare Before Christmas
metas.description: Jack Skellington, king of Halloween Town, stumbles through a portal to Christmas Town and becomes so enchanted that he decides to kidnap Santa Claus and take over the holiday.

metas.name: The Iron Giant
metas.description: A young boy befriends a giant robot from outer space that a paranoid government agent wants to destroy.

metas.name: Monster House
metas.description: Three teens discover that their neighbor's house is really a living, breathing, scary monster.

metas.name: Coraline
metas.description: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, a young girl discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life that seems too good to be true.

metas.name: The Simpsons Movie
metas.description: After Homer pollutes the town's water supply, Springfield is encased in a gigantic dome by the EPA and the Simpsons are declared fugitives.
A rag doll that awakens in a postapocalyptic future holds the key to humanity's salvation.

metas.name: Rango
metas.description: Rango is an ordinary chameleon who accidentally winds up in the town of Dirt, a lawless outpost in the Wild West in desperate need of a new sheriff.

metas.name: The Adventures of Tintin
metas.description: Intrepid reporter Tintin and Captain Haddock set off on a treasure hunt for a sunken ship commanded by Haddock's ancestor.
